Name: (CP) Dacar style portraits for Leilani
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
Boom, two in a day. Who would've thought.

I figured it would be nice to also add Keahi's mom to the list since I've finished redoing RSV! Now the family is all together! Just as the rest of my recent mods this is ready to be updated with animations once I can!

[size=2][b][color=#00ff00]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color]
[color=#00ff00]**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*[/color]
[color=#00ff00]Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.[/color]
[color=#00ff00]In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:[/color]

[color=#00ff00]-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP[/color]

[color=#00ff00]-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:[/color]
[color=#00ff00]"active": "HDP" [/color]
[color=#00ff00]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color][/b][/size]
